name: TradeCore ERP
description: v1.0.9 build 2026-09-08-27 BRANCH/STORE/CATEGORY PERSISTENCE FIX: (1) Branches and stores now write to MySQL via direct delta handlers WITH proper companyId forwarding and error logging — the branch handler was ignoring the companyId parameter (only destructured 2 args), so every branch write relied on the entity carrying its own company_id, which failed silently when it didn't; both handlers now pass companyId as fallback and log errors instead of swallowing them via .catch(() => {}). (2) Blob flush now includes DIRECT_SYNC keys (branches/stores/categories) as a reliability backstop — previously these were excluded from flushDirtyKeysRef so they only went through the direct MySQL path; if that failed silently, the data existed only in the optimistic local snapshot and vanished on refresh; now the blob flush always carries them, so the next snapshot assembly can pick them up even if the direct MySQL write failed. (3) Categories added from MasterData are company-scoped ('co_<companyId>:<name>') and handled by the direct delta path; categories from RootMandatePanel go through the same blob flush backstop.
